questions.content: When 2-butyne is treate with H<sub>2</sub>/Lindlar's catalyst,  compound X is produced as the major product and when treated with Na/liq. NH<sub>3</sub> it produces Y as the major product Which of the following statements is correct ?

options.content: X will have higher dipole moment and higher boiling point than Y.
Y will have higher dipole moment and higher boiling point than X.
X will have lower dipole moment and lower boiling point than Y.
Y will have higher dipole momet and lower boiling point than X.

questions.explanation:
Here dipole moment of Y = 0

cis-isomer(X) will have higher dipole moment and higher boiling point than trans (Y).
